rencontre.texte: What if you were no longer alone?

construction.texte: Igini analyses, guides and supports every step.

reussite.texte: An idea becomes a project. A project becomes reality.

accueil.communauteTexte: Make a project public when you are ready and receive encouragement from other project owners — nothing more for now, no private messaging and no rankings.

analyse.texte: A summary, a feasibility score, strengths, risks and next steps.

forme.texte: IGINI recommends a legal form, then drafts your articles of association for a professional to review.

dossier.texte: The documents, the fees to expect and a step-by-step guide to filing on the French one-stop shop (guichet unique). You file it yourself: Ignitux files nothing and pays nothing for you.

gestion.texte: Quotes and invoices, accounting, bank (entered by hand, no connection to your bank), cash register summary, stock, calendar and customer contacts.

equipe.texte: Invite your partner, an employee or your accountant: each one only sees what their role allows.

financement.texte: A financing plan prepared by IGINI, and a funding evaluation reviewed by Ignitux before it reaches you.

idee.texte: And you want to know if it holds up before putting your time and money into it.

creation.texte: In France: legal form, articles and creation file, step by step with IGINI.

entreprise.nom: You already run a small business
entreprise.texte: Your quotes, invoices, accounting, bank and stock in one place.

outils.gestion: Accounting, invoicing, bank, till, stock, calendar

igini.bienvenue: {n} free credits when you sign up
igini.affiche: The price shows before you start; nothing is charged if IGINI fails

prix.paiement: Top-ups of €{a}, €{b} or €{c} — card payment coming soon.

donnees.europe: Your database is hosted in the European Union (Ireland); some technical providers are in the United States, and the policy names each one.
donnees.vente: Your data is never sold, nor used for advertising.
donnees.export: From your account page, you can download everything — including the images of your ID — and delete your account whenever you want.
donnees.ia: When you use IGINI, Anthropic (United States), which provides its AI, receives the project content needed for the answer.

gratuit.r: The tools, yes: projects, accounting, invoicing, bank, team and funding are free for everyone, with no subscription. Only IGINI's actions are paid for, in credits (1 credit = €{valeur}); {n} credits are free when you sign up.

creation.q: Does Ignitux create my company for me?
creation.r: No. Ignitux prepares your file and walks you through filing it; you file it yourself on the French one-stop shop (guichet unique). Ignitux files nothing and pays nothing for you.

statuts.r: Not as they are. IGINI writes an AI-generated draft: have it reviewed by a professional (lawyer, chartered accountant) before using it.

ia.q: Is my data used to train an AI?
ia.r: No. No data is used to train an AI model, and nothing is sold.

equipe.q: Can I work with my business partner or my accountant?
equipe.r: Yes: invite them to your project with a role — partner, employee, accountant or observer. They need their own Ignitux account, and only see what their role allows. When a partner runs IGINI on your project, your credits are used.

telephone.q: Does it work on a phone?
telephone.r: Yes. Ignitux opens in your browser and installs like an app, on Android, iPhone and Windows.

pays.r: Company creation (legal form, articles, file) follows French rules for now. Other countries are not covered yet.

accueil.pret: Ready to bring your idea to life?
